name: knight-forms
_comment: The whole knight as a dozen shaded solid forms. Every pixel and its shadow/highlight is DERIVED by the engine from each form's material ramp + the sprite light — the author only decides which solid goes where, in what material. This is the 'note, not waveform' move for pixels: contrast the layer count and legibility with knight-pixels.json, the same figure hand-placed pixel by pixel. Masses are separated by material (iron limbs, gold accents) since same-material forms merge — the honest Phase-1 limitation that per-form depth/occlusion (Phase 2) removes.
